parts.title: The Climb Begins
parts.text: Kira, her brother Dmitri, and their cousin Lucas had planned the climb for months. With their guide, Mr. Voss, they began the long **ascent** up the mountain's snowy north face. By noon, the wind had turned **frigid**, stinging their cheeks even through thick scarves. Every step felt heavier than the last, but the summit seemed to glow in the distance, pulling them forward.

parts.title: The Roar
parts.text: Without warning, a low rumble shook the slope above them. "**Avalanche**!" Mr. Voss shouted. A wall of snow thundered past, and the group scattered. When the white cloud settled, Lucas was gone. Dmitri found him clinging to a narrow **ledge** above a deep **crevice**, a crack in the ice so wide it seemed bottomless. One slip, and Lucas would **plummet** into the darkness. The **precarious** edge crumbled beneath his boots.

parts.title: Holding On
parts.text: Kira tied a rope around a boulder and tossed the other end down as a **tether**. Hours passed, and the daylight began to **dwindle**. Their hands were numb, but they hauled with every ounce of **grit** they had. At last Mr. Voss lit an orange flare, a **beacon** that rescuers could spot from miles away. At sunrise, golden light began to **thaw** their frozen fingers, and a helicopter thumped overhead.

parts.title: Safe at Camp
parts.text: Back at base camp, Lucas sipped hot cocoa under a heavy blanket and thanked his cousins in a shaky voice. Kira realized that courage is not the absence of fear. It is staying calm and working together when everything feels impossible.
